gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Round, pen-drawn, unmistakably loud. Turret Road does its best work holding a constant line through big curves, while Noto Sans Cypriot is happiest keeping its e open and approachable.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Commanding curves from Turret Road keep the same pen-like line on every stroke, never heavier on the downstrokes, over Noto Sans Javanese. Its counters stay open to the outside, so paragraphs read smoothly.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-manichae: Turret Road draws rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord, commanding and bold, over Noto Sans Manichaean, with open-mouthed e crossbars. Rope-solid strength meets a quietly modern text face.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-mongolia: Rope-thick curves, round and commanding, with no fuss. Turret Road holds that heft steadily, and Noto Sans Mongolian, with flared terminals, keeps long paragraphs moving in a modern, neutral rhythm.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-: Commanding Turret Road draws round, unmodulated letters with no calligraphic swing. Noto Sans New Tai Lue follows with cupped, neutral round shapes that keep paragraphs flowing without looking clenched.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-nko: Noto Sans NKo keeps its c openings easy to see through. Turret Road, bold and commanding, draws round forms like open parentheses with a pen-plotter smoothness, and it carries that weight best at large sizes.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-quattrocento-sans: Quattrocento Sans leaves gaps that keep c from looking like o. Turret Road brings hairline-free, swell-free round forms and real muscle, while the modern, clean text below stays out of its way.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-rosario: Round, bold, and entirely free of shading, never swelling. Rosario, a contemporary sans-serif, never curls the ends of its c inward, so text stays approachable beneath the commanding Turret Road.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-sarabun: Wire-thick strokes in round, commanding forms, unchanged throughout. Sarabun, with a wide channel into every bowl, gives the bold curves of Turret Road an approachable counterweight in the text.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-shippori-antique: Round and commanding, Turret Road draws like a pen at constant weight, and Shippori Antique keeps a monoweight skeleton below. Big, short lines are where the heading earns its keep.
